scope: Local production-build browser verification in headless Chrome, 200% text simulated by root font-size. Not live production, ranking, indexing or Eve integration evidence.

change.before: email label rendered as plain text with word-break: break-all
change.after: email label support@<wbr>wadesinc.io with overflow-wrap: anywhere; mailto href, aria-label and copied text unchanged
change.markdown: mailto links in page Markdown whose text is the business address use the same label; other link text (Email us) unchanged

screenshots: 40 email-row and viewport captures per build (before and after); 36 identical pixel for pixel at 100% text, 4 differ by a 9x9px antialiasing shift at the @ glyph on the contact page card

axe_after.note: /, /services, /contact x light/dark x 320@200, 390@100, 1280@100; WCAG 2.2 A/AA tags. No before run: 0 after means no new violation.

acceptance.guard_mutation: restoring break-all on the contact band makes ci:contact-links fail 13 pass / 1 fail
acceptance.markdown_guard_mutation: removing the Markdown email label makes ci:markdown fail 14 pass / 1 fail

after_band_and_card_only.where: Markdown email links on /careers (and its three role pages), /privacy-policy, /terms-of-service, /service-offerings/engineered-septic-system-installation

sitewide_probe.note: In running text at 390px@200% the address now wraps after the @ mid-sentence instead of moving whole to the next line.
